description: Put your AI in your team's Slack. Post and read messages, reply in threads, route replies to the right session and forward chosen conversations. Start with whoami, then post.
author: Serg Parf

post.help: Send a message to a channel, or reply in a thread; the answer is the message link.

args.name: thread_ts
args.help: Reply in this Slack thread (JSON only)

args.name: username
args.help: Override this post’s display name (JSON only)

args.name: icon
args.help: Emoji name or image URL (JSON only)

read.help: Read recent messages in a channel, oldest first.
read.returns: Messages with timestamp, user and text

channels.help: Find channels, optionally by part of the name.

args.name: member_only
args.help: Only channels the bot joined (JSON only)

users.help: Find people by name or email; bots and deleted accounts are left out.

react.help: Add a reaction to a message.

args.name: emoji
args.help: Slack emoji name, for example white_check_mark

edit.help: Change one of the bot's own messages.

delete.help: Remove one of the bot's own messages.

join.help: Make the bot join a public channel.

whoami.help: See which bot you are talking to and its workspace.

refused.help: See the last 20 senders turned away by routing and not on the list; direct Owner and Maintainers only.

sub.add.help: Forward matching channel messages to a destination; the answer is the subscription ID.

sub.list.help: See your subscriptions and their sent and dropped counts; this agent’s direct Owner and Maintainers see all.

sub.delete.help: Delete your subscription, or any subscription as this agent’s direct Owner or Maintainer.

help.help: Show this agent's description and the help-config and help-secret asks.

users.help: Listed platform user ID → bus user; unlisted users are refused

tags.help: Pinned short tag → session agent; generated tags are permanent

route.help: Fallback bus destination for admitted, addressed messages

channels.help: Channel ID or #name → route, tags:false and/or anyone:true; or handler:drop alone to discard incoming messages and subscriptions (post still works)

channel.help: Slack #channel, channel ID or user email for a DM

target.help: Bus queue or agent destination; the author must be allowed to send to it and this helper

from_users.help: Author IDs, emails, @names or bot IDs; text uses from= before filter

filter.help: Common regular-expression subset, at most 200 characters; empty matches all selector messages
